name: Chart
summary: The AhaSlides chart library — one framework-free <aha-chart> for all 13 result and data charts (Bar, Column, Stacked, Donut, Radial, Tree map, Quadrant, Bell curve, Radar, Word cloud, Mind map, Line, NPS), in the brand palette on app screens or the deck palette on the presenting canvas.
highlights: One framework-free <aha-chart> for all 13 result and data charts
Bar, column (with negatives and a reference line), stacked, donut, radial, tree map, quadrant, bell curve, radar, word cloud, mind map, line, NPS distribution
Brand palette on app screens, deck palette on the canvas
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-chart type="…"> — draws every result chart with the same look wherever it is used: bar, column, stacked, donut (and pie), radial, treemap, quadrant, bell (answer distribution), radar, wordcloud, mindmap, line (1 to 4 series over time, with end-value labels and an optional twin axis) and nps (the 0 to 10 answers of an NPS question with detractor, passive and promoter brackets and the score; it takes per-score counts, raw ratings or bracket totals only). Where it lives decides its colours: palette="brand" (default) for Report and any other app screen uses the --aha-viz-* brand chart palette, or the host's own series colours when `colors` is set; palette="deck" on the presenting / audience canvas takes the deck's presentationColorPalette (`colors`) and text colour (`ink`), and derives any ink that sits on a fill from that fill's contrast. The chart never paints a background. Every variant of the reference mockup is an attribute or an `options` key: Poll, Pick Answer (`correct`) and Ranking (`sort="desc"`), images on bar/column options, count / % / both, pagination (`page-size`), donut vs pie and callout / legend labels, the word-cloud shapes, image masks, rotation, colour modes and duplicate merging, the radar forms, grids, scales and eight entrance effects, the bell-curve statistics, an editable mind map, negative columns below a zero baseline and a dashed reference line on a column chart, grouped (side-by-side) columns, optional axis titles on bar, column and line, and line gaps, end labels and twin axes. With 0 responses every bar and column shows a short coloured stub at its starting point — no placeholder bars — and donut, pie and tree map also show one short text, "No responses yet", in the chart's own ink, centred in the plot. Live data animates in place (marks grow, resize and re-rank on the --aha-motion-viz-* tokens; off under reduced motion; `replay()` re-runs the entrance), and every chart ships a text summary, a visually hidden data table and a polite live-region announcement when its data changes. Built-in copy follows `locale`, numbers use Intl for that locale, and the host can override any of it through `strings` (an object property or a JSON attribute).
codeNote: Set `data` (and `options`) as properties for live results — re-setting them animates the change; the `data` / `options` attributes take the same JSON for static pages. Interactive charts emit `wordcloud-hide` (a presenter hid words) and `mindmap-change` (an idea was added or renamed; detail.tree is the new tree). Result charts on app screens use this, not @ant-design/plots.

spec.label: Types
spec.value: bar · column · stacked · donut · pie · radial · treemap · quadrant · bell · radar · wordcloud · mindmap · line · nps

spec.label: Palette
spec.value: brand = --aha-viz-series-1…6 → the four chart colours of the colour rules, in order: Vivid Pink · black · Vivid Pink at 30% · light grey #A8A8A8, then Vivid Pink · black again (past four series, add a dashed line or pattern and a written label); tints → Vivid Pink at 5% behind the pink series, gray-20 behind the black and grey series · Other / non-correct → icon-muted · correct → answer-correct (Correct green) in both palettes · deck = consumer colours + ink · colors on palette=brand replaces the series (and their 16% tints) with the host's colours, keeping the brand ink · transparent background · more than 6 bar/column options share series 1

spec.label: Ink
spec.value: ink → text-default · secondary → text-secondary · tertiary → text-tertiary · axis → border-strong · grid → border · track → border-secondary · hover → bg-hover · pressed → border · mark outline → ink-a10 · tooltip → bg-dark + text-inverse · on a deck the same roles are re-derived from the deck ink (76 / 54 / 24 / 12 / 8 / 12 / 12 / 16 % mixes)

spec.label: Bar
spec.value: track 34 (28 past 6 options) · gap --aha-viz-bar-gap (space-32) between options, label-to-bar --aha-space-8, so a label sits closer to its own bar than to the one above · radius --aha-radius-default (track, fill and empty stub) · label --aha-size-xl on the left of a head line above the bar, value --aha-size-xl / semibold + share --aha-size-l tertiary on the right of the same line, the track under it spanning the row · image thumbnail at the end of the row = bar + label gap (--aha-space-8) + one head line, bottom-aligned so the bar sits on the image edge; image-only options leave the head line to the value · when any option has an image every row keeps the image column, and an option without one shows a tile in the track colour with a centred image glyph (system-image-square, --_ink-3), so every track starts and ends at the same x and bars stay comparable · labels one line with an ellipsis, always at least --aha-space-16 clear of the value (full text in the tooltip and data table) · value readout right-aligned in a column sized to the widest final value in the chart (measured on data, resize and font load, not the count-up text), so the values line up · page-size pages with a ‹ › pager

spec.label: Column
spec.value: plot 260 (+100 with images) · column ≤96 wide in a slot ≤240 wide · gap 28 (20 past 6, 8 under 480) · label --aha-size-xl, clamps to 5 lines · turns into bars when a label can't fit its slot in 4 lines · min height --aha-viz-column-min-height 16 · columns that do not fill the width sit together in the centre · grouped (data with series): one column per series side by side inside each row's group (up to 4 series, the palette's four distinct colours; negatives count as 0), group labels under the baseline, the value above each column (hidden when the column is too narrow for it; the tooltip and data table always carry it), a series legend, series hover dims the others · sort, highlight-top, Pick Answer, images and log-scale do not apply

spec.label: Column · negatives and reference
spec.value: any negative value or options.reference switches the column chart to a zero baseline: the baseline is a 1px --aha-border-strong rule, a positive column grows up from it with its top corners rounded and its value above, a negative column grows down with its bottom corners rounded and its value below, all in the first series colour when any value is negative (direction by position and shape, never hue) · reference {value, label}: a 1px dashed --aha-text-secondary line across the plot with the label and value at its right end, in a right gutter the columns never enter; when the label would take more than 30% of the width it moves to a key above the plot (a dashed swatch and the text, ending in an ellipsis) · once signed, the chart stays signed, so live data crossing zero animates in place · labels that do not fit their columns on two lines (a phone, or many periods) stay on one line and show every Nth label, counted back from the latest, which is always labelled; they never end in an ellipsis · a value label never overlaps another bar or label: it steps down to 14px, then 12px, and if they still collide only the clear ones are shown, counted back from the latest, which is always shown · columns stay columns in this mode (no fall-back to bars), images and Pick Answer are not drawn

spec.label: Line
spec.value: 1 to 4 series in the chart order (Vivid Pink, black, Vivid Pink at 30%, light grey; a fifth is dropped) · 2.5px straight segments; null (or a missing value) breaks the line and a lone point keeps its marker · each series has its own marker shape (circle, square, triangle, diamond), drawn only at labelled ticks and the last point · y axis starts at zero (options.zero=false to fit the data) with 3 to 6 nice divisions (the count near the height-based target that wastes the least span, so a top value of 50 reads 0 to 50), grid --aha-border-default and the zero / base line --aha-border-strong · x labels thin out to every Nth period, counted back from the latest so the last period is always labelled · end-value labels (14px semibold ink) at the right; labels that would overlap are pushed apart as a group around their points and joined by a 1.25px leader in the series colour · twin axis: series with axis:'right' scale to a right axis with the same divisions, and the legend names each series' axis (left axis) / (right axis); end labels sit outside the right-axis ticks · format number | compact (12K, 1.3M) | percent (whole %, values as fractions), rightFormat for the right axis · legend above the plot when there is more than one series or a twin axis · hover shows a dashed guide and every series' value for that period · a single period sits at the right edge beside its end label · new data morphs the existing lines to the new values (same periods), anything else redraws

spec.label: Axis titles
spec.value: x-title and y-title (bar, column, line): one line of --aha-size-l text in --aha-text-secondary; the y title sits above the plot at its left edge, the x title is centred under it (both horizontal, never rotated); hidden when empty; other types ignore them

spec.label: NPS
spec.value: data: 11 per-score counts, raw ratings ({ratings}) or bracket totals only ({promoters, passives, detractors}); any object may add score, shown instead of the computed one · per-score data: 11 columns, ratings 0 to 10, in the column look at a tighter gap (--aha-space-8; 2px under 480) · bracket rules (--aha-space-4 high, pill ends) span detractors 0–6, passives 7–8, promoters 9–10, each with name (semibold) and count · share; under 480px the names move to a key row with swatches · NPS score = displayed promoter share − displayed detractor share (so it matches the rounded percentages shown), signed (NPS +26, NPS 0), shown under the brackets (options.showScore) and first in the summary · counts are rounded to whole numbers · under 480px the column counts use compact notation (18K) · 0 responses: bars, brackets and key are hidden and the "No responses yet" note shows · colours: colors = detractor, passive, promoter on either palette, matched by position (a missing or invalid entry takes that bracket's default, never another bracket's colour); default the brand series only (detractor series 2, passive --aha-viz-neutral, promoter series 1; on palette=deck with --aha-viz-series-2 unset the detractor takes the deck ink) · hover or focus on a column or bracket highlights the bracket · table: one row per rating, then one per bracket · bracket totals only: no columns; one bar split by bracket share (the stacked bar look, --aha-viz-bar-thickness high, --aha-space-16 above), the key row with swatches at every width, and the score; table rows are the brackets only

spec.label: Pick Answer
spec.value: correct = index (or data item correct:true): a 20px <aha-answer-mark> (white ✓ on a solid --aha-answer-correct disc) + bold ink label (colour rules 11.2, 11.3); correct-style=fill (default, as the mockup) paints the correct mark --aha-answer-correct in both palettes and the rest neutral; incorrect options are left unmarked; correct-style=indicator keeps palette colours (canvas.guide Job 1 / Job 2)

spec.label: Donut · pie · radial · tree map
spec.value: 6 slices max (the rest fold into "Other (n)") · donut ring 38% (pie: no hole) · slice 1 alone takes series 1 and later slices cycle series 2–4 (deck: the deck colours after the first), so the last slice never matches the first · 2px slice gap in --aha-viz-slice-gap (default the container white; on a deck the inverse ink) · leader-line callouts up to 5 slices from 480px wide, else a legend · radial 270° rings on a nice scale · squarified tree map with tint chips · only the first 4 slices have distinct fills (brand: Vivid Pink, black, Vivid Pink at 30%, light grey): slices 5 and 6 repeat slices 2 and 3, so the callout or legend label always names the slice and colour never carries it alone · small host: a host with a set height or a narrow width caps the plot (the pie shrinks to at most the host width, down to 80px); callouts need a host at least 224px tall, else the legend takes the labels; the legend wraps below the pie in a narrow host, is limited to half the width beside it, and scrolls inside the host when it is taller than the room left

spec.label: Bell · radar · quadrant
spec.value: bell: monotone curve per statement (≤6), average badge, optional grid / % axis / mean line · radar: 5 | 10 | 100 scales, filled / outline / radial bars, polygon / circle grid, 8 entrance effects, subject toggles, data table · quadrant: 2×2 zones, ≤3 colour groups, collision-aware labels

spec.label: Word cloud · mind map
spec.value: word cloud: rect / ellipse / cloud / speech bubble / heart / bulb / custom image mask, rotation, palette / top-3 / ink colour, √ / linear / log sizing, duplicate merging (case, punctuation, accents), click-to-hide with undo · mind map: balanced two-sided layout (one-sided, then an outline when narrow), 5 levels, 6 branches, +N paging, collapse, optional add / rename

spec.label: Empty
spec.value: 0 responses → every bar/column/stacked row keeps its track (a stacked row shows one half-length stub per series side by side, rounded only at the left end) and shows a series-coloured stub at its start: a bar stub --aha-viz-stub-length 12px long, a column stub the full column width and --aha-viz-column-min-height 16px tall (under an image it joins the image card, which rounds only the outer corners), all marks, stubs and image cards rounded with --aha-radius-default · donut / tree map keep the track · radar breathes its entrance effect until the first response · donut / pie / tree map / line / nps also show the text "No responses yet" centred in the plot (--_ink-3, not announced twice: the summary already says it; the donut centre count is hidden) and it disappears on the first response · every other type shows no text

spec.label: Overflow
spec.value: percentages use largest-remainder rounding so they total 100% · bar labels truncate to one line, other long labels clamp; the full text is always in the tooltip · a column with long labels becomes bars · a wide mind map pages its ideas · a donut or pie in a host with a set height (height on <aha-chart> or its parent, with the chart set to height:100%) never overflows it

spec.label: Motion
spec.value: enter 600ms + 40ms stagger · update 400ms · re-rank 350ms · values count up with their marks · --aha-ease-viz · none under prefers-reduced-motion

spec.label: A11y
spec.value: host role=figure + aria-label · text summary · hidden data table (mind map: nested list) · polite <aha-live-region> on data updates · interactive parts (pager, legend toggles, words, mind-map nodes, quadrant points, radar axes) are real buttons with labels

spec.label: Copy
spec.value: every key overrides through `strings`; {name} placeholders are filled in, plural keys take {one, other} (any Intl plural category) · type names: typeNames.{bar, column, stacked, donut, pie, radial, treemap, quadrant, bell, radar, wordcloud, mindmap, line, nps} (accessible name, table caption, summaries) · shared: other, otherCount, optionNumber, responses, responsesUnit, people, submissions, item, count, share, word, level, group, average, correct, rank, value, period, noValue · empty state: emptyNote (the visible "No responses yet"), emptySummary, lineEmpty, radarNoResponses · pager: page, rankPage, previousPage, nextPage · summaries and live region: summary, leader, correctSummary, stackedSummary, signedSummary, referenceSummary, lineSummary, lineLatest, wordcloudSummary, wordcloudLeader, mindmapSummary, quadrantSummary, bellSummary, bellStatement, radarSummary, radarSubject, updated · legends, axes and tooltips: leftAxis, rightAxis, radialScale, quadrantTooManyGroups, bellLevel, bellAverage, radarAverage, radarSubjectFallback, radarMeta, radarScale · word cloud controls: wordcloudHidden, wordcloudUndo, wordcloudRestoreAll, wordcloudAllHidden, wordcloudHideHint, wordcloudHideHintTouch, wordcloudHideKey, wordcloudMerged · NPS: npsDetractors, npsPassives, npsPromoters, npsScore, npsRating, npsSummary · mind map controls: mindmapMore, mindmapLevel, mindmapChildren, mindmapCollapse, mindmapExpand, mindmapAdd, mindmapAddBranch, mindmapMaxBranches, mindmapNewIdea, mindmapEdit, mindmapEditHint, mindmapNotEmpty · the chart draws no other user-visible text

props.name: type
props.desc: Chart type

props.name: data
props.desc: bar/column: [{label?, value, image?, correct?}] (column: a negative value draws below the zero baseline) (label may be omitted when image is set; screen readers and tooltips then say "Option N" · on bar, options without an image show a placeholder tile when any other option has one) · donut/radial/treemap: [{label, value}] · wordcloud: [{label, value}] or [strings] · stacked: {series, rows:[{label, values}]} · bell: {scale, anchors, series:[{label, counts}]} · radar: {dimensions, scale, subjects:[{label, scores, responses}], people} · quadrant: {x, y, zones, groups, points:[{label, x, y, group}]} · mindmap: {label, children} · line: {labels:[periods], series:[{label, values:[number | null], axis?: 'left' | 'right'}]} (1 to 4 series; null breaks the line) · column, grouped: {series:[names], rows:[{label, values}]} (the stacked shape) or {labels, series:[{label, values}]} (the line shape), 1 to 4 series side by side per row · nps: [11 counts for ratings 0 to 10] or {counts}, or {ratings: [each response's 0 to 10 rating, a number or {score}]} (anything else skipped), or {promoters, passives, detractors} (bracket totals only: a split bar and key, no per-score columns); any object may add score (shown instead of the computed NPS)

props.name: options
props.desc: Type-specific settings — donut/pie {variant, labels, maxSize} · radial/quadrant {maxSize} · treemap {height} · bell {height, show*} · radar {height, form, grid, rings, scoreStyle, reveal, pace, show*, hollowCentre} · wordcloud {height, shape, maskSrc, rotation, colour, fontScale, removable, showTooltip, showCounts, group, foldDiacritics, maxWords} · mindmap {pageSize, maxDepth, maxBranches, editable} · column {reference: {value, label}} (a dashed reference line, label at the right end) · line {height, endLabels, format, rightFormat, zero} (format: number | compact | percent) · nps {showScore}

props.name: palette
props.desc: brand on app screens (Report…); deck on the presenting/audience canvas

props.name: colors
props.desc: Series colours from the host, in series order, with either palette: on palette=deck the deck's presentationColorPalette; on palette=brand a palette the host app owns (a survey's answer colours), in place of --aha-viz-series-*. Unset or no valid colour keeps the palette's own series. The host picks the hues; the chart only applies them · nps: the brackets, in the order detractor, passive, promoter

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck text colour (palette=deck)

props.name: number-format
props.desc: What each value shows

props.name: sort
props.desc: Order; desc also shows rank numbers on a bar chart (the Ranking variant), each in the Leaderboard rank chip (32px neutral circle on the track colour, 16px semibold tabular number) at the start of the label line. Other always stays last

props.name: highlight-top
props.desc: Dim everything below the top N

props.name: correct
props.desc: Pick Answer: the correct option(s), e.g. "1" (or correct:true on a data item)

props.name: correct-style
props.desc: fill paints the correct mark the answer-correct green (both palettes) and the rest neutral (the mockup); indicator keeps palette colours and marks the answer with ✓ only

props.name: page-size
props.desc: Bar: options per page, with a ‹ › pager (ranks carry across pages)

props.name: log-scale
props.desc: Log lengths for bar/column when values span orders of magnitude

props.name: legend
props.desc: Auto: on for stacked, tree map, quadrant groups, multi-subject radar, and a donut or pie without callouts

props.name: x-title
props.desc: Bar, column, line: title of the horizontal axis, centred under the plot (a bar chart's horizontal axis is its value axis)

props.name: y-title
props.desc: Bar, column, line: title of the vertical axis, above the plot at its left edge (a bar chart's vertical axis is its option axis)

props.name: tooltip
props.desc: Hover tooltip with the full label and value

props.name: max-items
props.desc: Cap before the smallest fold into "Other (n)"

props.name: responses
props.desc: Respondent count for the summary and the donut centre (a pie has no centre)

props.name: locale
props.desc: Built-in copy (en, vi) + Intl number format

props.name: strings
props.desc: Override any built-in string (every key of chartStrings.en, listed under Copy) with the product's own copy or translation; keys you leave out fall back to the locale's built-in copy (en, vi), then en. Merge is per key; typeNames merges per type. The property wins over the attribute until the attribute changes

props.name: label
props.desc: Accessible name + data-table caption

props.name: replay()
props.desc: Re-runs the entrance animation with the current data

whenToUse.when: results on the presenting or audience canvas of a slide type — Poll, Pick Answer, Ranking, Rating scale, Split the points, Quadrant, Word cloud, Brainstorm/Mind map
the same results anywhere else in the Presenter app — Report, dashboards, summaries

type="bar" — compare counts across categorical options: long labels, many options (no cap unless max-items is set; extras fold into "Other (n)"), ranking (sort="desc" adds rank numbers), image options, Pick Answer with several options. Serves Poll and Ranking. Not for part-to-whole of one question (use donut) or a time series (use line).

type="column" — the same comparison for a few short options (Poll, Pick Answer correct reveal). It turns into bars on its own when the labels do not fit the width, so choose bar directly for long labels or many options. Not for part-to-whole (use donut). Negative values draw below a zero baseline (net change, gain and loss); options.reference adds a dashed target or average line. Give it {series, rows} data to compare 1 to 4 series side by side per row (grouped columns).

type="stacked" — composition of several groups or statements side by side, each row split by the same series (up to 6 series, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Use when you compare how groups divide, not for one question (use donut).

type="donut" (a ring with the respondent total in the centre) or type="pie" (a solid pie with no centre hole, same slices, palette, labels, legend and tooltip) — part-to-whole of ONE question with few categories (up to 6 slices, the rest fold into "Other (n)"; up to 5 get leader-line callouts when the chart is at least 480px wide, otherwise a legend). Not for many slices or values close together (use bar).
type="radial" — a few shares or percentages shown compactly as concentric rings (up to 6, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Not for many items or exact comparison (use bar).
type="treemap" — part-to-whole across many categories of very different size (up to 6 tiles, the rest fold into "Other (n)"). Not for precise comparison of close values (use bar).
type="quadrant" — items scored on two axes, such as effort against impact, placed in four labelled quadrants (up to three colour groups). Not for one-dimensional scores (use bar).

type="bell" — how answers are distributed on an ordered or numeric scale: one counts array per scale step, one curve per statement (up to 6) with an average, so the spread, skew or split shows, not just the mean. Use it whenever someone wants to see the distribution of answers, e.g. Rating scale results. Not for unordered categorical options (use bar).
type="radar" — several criteria scored on the same scale (5, 10 or 100), comparing the profile of one or a few subjects. Not for criteria on unrelated scales or a single score (use bar).
type="wordcloud" — frequency of short free-text answers (one string per response, or counted words; up to 120 words shown, duplicates merged). Serves Word cloud. Not for exact counts (use bar).
type="mindmap" — grouped or hierarchical ideas as a tree of labels (default up to 5 levels and 6 branches). Serves Brainstorm and Mind map. Not for quantities (use bar or donut).

type="line" — how 1 to 4 figures moved over time (weekly sign-ups, monthly usage); null marks a period with no data and breaks the line. Put a series on axis:'right' only when its unit differs (a rate beside a count); the legend then names each series' axis. Not for a handful of categories (use column) or a single figure against the last period (use a Stat tile).
a single headline number, not a distribution (Stat tile when it is compared with the previous period)
a chart type <aha-chart> does not ship (area, scatter)

opinion.note: Never hand-roll result bars with divs or pull a chart engine into the slide canvas: the look, the empty/overflow states and the accessibility layer live here once. Pick Answer follows the mockup by default (correct mark filled with --aha-answer-correct in both palettes, the rest neutral, plus the green tick disc on the label); set correct-style="indicator" where the canvas guide's Job 1 / Job 2 split applies (palette-coloured marks, ✓ only). The --aha-viz-* values are lifted from the PRO38-69 mockup and are expected to be refined by a token owner; change the tokens, never the element. Start from the chart type's default snippet (`typeDefaults`, one per type) and only ADD attributes or options — never strip or override its data shape: the default is the minimal markup that already has the full intended behaviour (entrance animation, live-update motion, tooltip, legend, empty state, text summary, hidden data table and live-region announcement) with no opt-in attribute. A few things are opt-in only and must be set explicitly: ranking (sort="desc"), Pick Answer (correct), pagination (page-size), highlight-top, log-scale, bell grid / % axis / mean line / step labels, radar data table / scale ticks / hollow centre, word cloud counts / diacritic folding / shapes / rotation / masks, and an editable mind map.
opinion.dsv3: New in the DS (PRO38-69) — the visual source is the "AhaSlides Chart Slides" mockup; a signed-off exception to the @ant-design/plots rule for result charts.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI. The [data-probe] is the ranked brand-palette bar chart: first fill is --aha-viz-series-1, the track and value sizes are the mockup's, the host is a labelled figure and the hidden table carries one row per option.
